sections.heading: 👋 Welcome to Glide!
sections.content:
Glide is building banking infrastructure to help financial institutions modernize. We combine stunning UI/UX with reliable architecture to enable financial institutions to launch digital and mobile experiences for their customers.
You’ll be joining an all-star team with engineering, product, and growth experience from Stripe, Google, and Amazon. We’re looking for a talented Product Designer to help us build our initial product. We’re bringing a new perspective to the decades-old financial world, and we’re hoping you can help us do that!

sections.heading: Your Responsibilities:
sections.content:
Take ownership to define the foundation for the Glide product from its early stages. You will be involved at every step of product development, from brainstorming broad ideas to ensure design quality through launch.
Collaborate ruthlessly. Work closely with our developers and Chief Product Officer on vision setting, implementation, and polishing screens, pixel for pixel, quickly.
Be natively cross-functional. You can move fluidly between different focus areas like app web, and graphic design.
Communicate and update timelines with the team and help outline the product roadmap.

sections.heading: About You
sections.content:
You have experience designing from scratch. You have experience turning broadly defined concepts into tactical deliverables.
You understand how parts of a system fit together—and are able to extrapolate and extend shared patterns and behaviors.
You are comfortable working with an iterative design process. You can work quickly and act on feedback.
You have a great design sense. You value crafting beautiful and delightful user experiences. You are familiar with native design paradigms for web and mobile, have a strong eye for design, and are attentive to details.

sections.heading: Nice-to-Have’s:
sections.content:
3+ years of full-time product design experience (web and mobile).
1+ years of full-time graphic design experience.
1+ years of experience with Figma.

sections.heading: 💸 Competitive Compensation:
sections.content: You’ll receive a competitive salary and a generous equity package for joining us at Glide.

sections.heading: ❤️ Wellbeing Credits
sections.content: Besides stellar health, dental, and vision insurance, we offer a generous health and wellness stipend, so you can stay healthy and active.

sections.heading: 🥗 Lunch on us
sections.content: We love food. Every member of the Glide team gets free lunch, every day. No one goes hungry around here :)

sections.heading: 💻 Best Tools
sections.content: We want you to be happy at work. You'll get the top-of-the-line computer and your preference on keyboard, mouse, and accessories.
